params.caption: 🎮 Marvel Rivals director responds to hate speech row Marvel Rivals' creative director has addressed the controversy that followed a September incident, when hate speech was removed from the game's reporting system. He says the team has "ramped up our disciplinary measures" against offenders, aiming to win back trust from a community that reacted strongly. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 20:34 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer 🛡️ Like if you want stricter bans · 💬 Is it enough? Tell us below #MarvelRivals #GamingNews
